description.hook_first_125: One ordinary market morning. One impossible shrink. Mira has until closing time to get big again — nobody believes her.
description.full_text: One ordinary market morning. One impossible shrink. Mira has until closing time to get big again — and nobody believes a three-inch girl. A stylized 3D animated short film about courage at a very small scale, made for families. Watch Mira navigate towering fruit stalls, dodge shopping baskets, and find help in the least likely place. If you enjoyed this adventure, subscribe for the next short film. #animation #shortfilm #familymovie
